productIdentity.tagline: Know what can change. Control what does. Prove the result.

definitionOfDone.title: Universal bounded repository understanding
definitionOfDone.definition: Understand supported repository structure and relationships with explicit evidence boundaries and explicit UNKNOWN for unsupported or unproven areas.

definitionOfDone.title: Useful Impact Radius
definitionOfDone.definition: Resolve a useful conservative blast radius with evidence and unknowns, without converting impact into authorization.

definitionOfDone.title: Edge provenance
definitionOfDone.definition: Material graph edges expose source/provenance and confidence or remain inference/unknown.

definitionOfDone.title: Better UNKNOWN
definitionOfDone.definition: UNKNOWN is first-class, reasoned and actionable with next evidence. It is never PASS_WITH_WARNING.

definitionOfDone.title: Conflict-first authority
definitionOfDone.definition: Authority candidates, conflicts, staleness and protected boundaries are resolved fail-closed before mutation authorization.

definitionOfDone.title: Change comparison
definitionOfDone.definition: Comparable before/after states produce deterministic bounded deltas tied to the same repository/snapshot lineage.

definitionOfDone.title: Agent-neutral independent verification
definitionOfDone.definition: Verification consumes evidence through agent-neutral contracts; independent replication requires an actually independent evaluator.

definitionOfDone.title: Portable reproducible runner
definitionOfDone.definition: Documented runner modes replay from declared inputs without hidden founder-workstation dependencies.

definitionOfDone.title: Evidence Bundle
definitionOfDone.definition: Portable evidence packages preserve provenance, gaps, classifications and replay/handoff context without pretending partial evidence is complete.

definitionOfDone.title: Utility evidence
definitionOfDone.definition: Human and agent utility claims require external measured evidence, not feature count, plausibility or internal demos.

invariants: Snapshot/provenance lock is required for proof-bearing claims
Verification must be agent-neutral; same-agent assertion is not independent verification

forbidden: PASS_WITH_WARNING as a substitute for UNKNOWN
PASS from partial scan presented as complete
production/enterprise/paid-pilot claims from this contract alone

nonGoals: Rebuild Universal Intelligence or Customer Wow capabilities that are already DONE/VERIFY and doNotRebuild.
Rewrite historical evidence to erase the deprecated product name.
Break internal imports, persisted schemas or stable automation paths for cosmetic renaming.
Claim production certification, enterprise readiness or paid-pilot readiness from source/governance documents alone.

changeAssurancePacketV1.purpose: Portable proof-bearing handoff for a bounded change decision. It composes existing Code Atlas, Authority Mesh, verification and Evidence Bundle truth; it is not a new analysis or authority engine.
changeAssurancePacketV1.producer: PRISMA Change Assurance using existing Code Atlas and PRISMA governance evidence

fieldContracts.authorizedSnapshot: Exact authority-bound commit/tree plus request and authority artifact digests.
fieldContracts.currentSnapshot: Exact current commit/tree observed for the handoff.
fieldContracts.driftClassification: PASS_ALREADY_CURRENT | PASS_NO_RELEVANT_DRIFT | BLOCKED_RELEVANT_DRIFT | BLOCKED_NON_ANCESTOR_DRIFT | BLOCKED_INVALID_PRIOR_AUTHORITY | FRESH_TASK_EXACT_AUTHORITY
fieldContracts.affectedAuthority: Explicit changed authority/protected paths; empty only when evidence proves no relevant drift.
fieldContracts.protectedScope: Explicit do-not-touch/authority boundaries from the governing pack/readset.
fieldContracts.provenance: Must link producer, consumer, contract, repository snapshot, Authority Mesh/revalidation, verification gates, Evidence Bundle and Factory Ledger evidence by immutable IDs/digests where available.
fieldContracts.unknowns: Missing, stale, contradictory or unsupported evidence remains explicit and can force UNKNOWN/BLOCKED.
fieldContracts.pullRequest: PR number plus exact head SHA. mergeSha is null until GitHub reports the merge.
fieldContracts.postMergeProof: Required for any merged-change completion claim and must bind the exact merge SHA/current canonical HEAD to post-merge evidence.
fieldContracts.claimBoundary: Must state what the packet proves and does not prove. Packaging cannot create production, enterprise, paid-pilot, human-usefulness or independent-verification claims.

evidenceChain.role: product contract and PASS/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN decision boundary
portable sanitized evidence and replay/handoff binding
canonical anti-rework status, next gate and do-not-rebuild truth

hardRules: No merge SHA may be invented before merge.
No post-merge completion claim without exact merge-SHA evidence.
No production or COMMERCIALIZATION_READY claim from this packet alone.

ownershipBoundary.rule: Resolve ownership from the canonical registry boundary, never from a physical filename, directory token or legacy compatibility identifier.
